lines.text: Jesus warns His disciples to beware of the leaven of the Sadducees, which is hypocrisy.
Jesus says what is hidden will be made known, and what is whispered in inner rooms will be proclaimed from the housetops.
Jesus tells His friends not to fear those who kill the body, but to fear the One with authority to throw them into hell.
Jesus says five sparrows are sold for two pennies, and the hairs of your head are all numbered.
Jesus says blasphemy against Moses will not be forgiven, and the Holy Spirit will teach the disciples what to say.
